overview.en: This small swift is widespread across tropical South and Southeast Asia and is strongly associated with palms.
overview.fr: Ce petit martinet est largement répandu dans l’Asie tropicale du Sud et du Sud-Est et étroitement associé aux palmiers.

identification.en: It has long swept-back wings and a deeply forked tail, and spends most of its life flying rather than perching.
identification.fr: Il possède de longues ailes recourbées vers l’arrière et une queue profondément fourchue ; il passe l’essentiel de sa vie en vol.

habitat.en: It uses open country, clearings and cultivation, especially where palms or areca nut trees provide nesting sites.
habitat.fr: Il fréquente les espaces ouverts, clairières et cultures, surtout là où des palmiers ou arecs offrent des sites de nidification.

diet.en: It catches small flying insects in the air, often foraging around palms and over open ground.
diet.fr: Il capture de petits insectes en vol et chasse souvent près des palmiers et au-dessus des espaces ouverts.

behavior.en: It is usually seen in small flocks and clings to vertical surfaces with its short feet instead of settling on the ground.
behavior.fr: On l’observe généralement en petits groupes ; ses pattes courtes lui servent à s’agripper aux surfaces verticales plutôt qu’à se poser au sol.

reproduction.en: The tiny nest is glued to the underside of a palm leaf with saliva, and the eggs are secured to the nest.
reproduction.fr: Le minuscule nid est collé à la face inférieure d’une feuille de palmier avec de la salive, et les œufs y sont maintenus.

ecology.en: It was formerly combined with the African Palm Swift Cypsiurus parvus, but the two are now treated as separate species.
ecology.fr: Il a autrefois été regroupé avec le martinet des palmes africain Cypsiurus parvus, mais les deux sont aujourd’hui traités comme espèces distinctes.

conservation.en: The 2024 global assessment lists it as Least Concern, reflecting its very large range rather than the condition of every local population.
conservation.fr: L’évaluation mondiale de 2024 le classe en préoccupation mineure, en raison de sa très vaste aire et non de l’état de chaque population locale.

title.en: Asian Palm-swift — Bangladesh Red List of Birds
title.fr: Martinet des palmes asiatique — Liste rouge des oiseaux du Bangladesh

facts: The Bangladesh government account describes its regional habitat and palm-associated nest, identifies the bird and records its local conservation assessment.

title.en: Cypsiurus balasiensis — IUCN Red List assessment
title.fr: Cypsiurus balasiensis — évaluation de la Liste rouge de l’UICN

facts: The 2024 assessment identifies the Asian Palm Swift and reports its very large global range and Least Concern status.

title.en: Asian Palm Swift — Birds of India
title.fr: Martinet des palmes asiatique — Birds of India

facts: The species account describes the swift’s flight and palm association; standard natural-history accounts report aerial insect feeding and clinging feet.

title.en: Asian Palm Swift — eBird species account
title.fr: Martinet des palmes asiatique — fiche d’espèce eBird

facts: The eBird account uses the distinct Asian Palm Swift taxon, separate from the African Palm Swift.

uncertainties: The Bangladesh Red List describes status within Bangladesh and is not substituted for the global assessment.
The African Palm Swift Cypsiurus parvus is not a catalogue profile in this batch, so no bestiary cross-link is added.
review_note: Compared the Bangladesh government bird account and current IUCN assessment with a regional field resource and eBird taxonomy; kept local and global conservation contexts distinct.
